click_channel.description: TimeTagger input channel receiving photon clicks.

click_trigger.description: Trigger threshold in volts for the photon-click channel.

enabled.description: If ``false`` the manager is constructed but ``initiateScan`` is a no-op.

fit_method.description: Lifetime fit method; one of ``"moment"``, ``"phasor"``, ``"exp1"``.  All three apply automatic IRF-peak compensation (see "Lifetime fitting" below); ``exp1`` is the most accurate for clean mono-exponential decays.

laser_rep_rate_mhz.description: Laser repetition rate in MHz.  Used by the phasor fit to set ω = 2π·f_rep.  The Swabian ``Flim`` API does not expose the rate, so it must be supplied here; measure it once with ``scripts/diagnostics/measure_laser_rep_rate.py`` if unsure.

line_channel.description: TimeTagger input channel receiving the per-line marker.

line_trigger.description: Trigger threshold in volts for the per-line marker channel.

min_counts_per_pixel.description: Minimum photon count for a pixel's fit to be considered valid; below this the lifetime is treated as NaN.

n_bins.description: Number of TCSPC histogram bins per pixel.

start_channel.description: TimeTagger input channel receiving the TCSPC start (sync) signal.

start_trigger.description: Trigger threshold in volts for the TCSPC start/sync channel.

trigger_levels.description: Backward-compatible dict mapping channel-number-as-string to trigger threshold in volts.  Used only to seed the per-role ``click_trigger`` / ``start_trigger`` / ``line_trigger`` defaults.  Direct per-role fields take precedence.
